fields.label: Relationship Type
fields.description: Relationship between guardian and student (e.g., Father, Mother, Grandfather, etc.)

fields.label: Key Person
fields.description: Primary contact for this family relationship

fields.label: Access Granted
fields.description: Whether this guardian has access to student information

fields.label: Pickup Authorized
fields.description: Allowed to pick this student up at the school gate. Independent of Access Granted: a hired driver / helper may pick the student up without seeing any student information, and a parent whose information access was revoked (special family circumstances) may still be barred from the gate. Default is 1 so existing relationships keep the current behaviour (every relationship could pick up); untick it explicitly for people who must not collect the student.

fields.label: Display Order
fields.description: Thu tu uu tien hien thi (primary luon dung dau)
